name: Tsukano Kou
source:
One of the Hakkenshi, he holds the mark of 'filial piety' on his body.
A quiet and cool guy who is surrounded by mystery.
He doesn't hide the fact that he wouldn't betray anyone for money.
He often skips school because his body is frail.
